verses.en: Woe unto the defrauders

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
verses.en: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full
But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss
Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
Unto an Awful Day
The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينࣲ‏
verses.en: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin
Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is
A written record
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Those who deny the Day of Judgment

verses.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor

verses.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old

verses.ar: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.en: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
verses.en: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord
Then lo! they verily will burn in hell

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.en: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin
Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is
A written record
Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)
Lo! the righteous verily are in delight
On couches, gazing
Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight
They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed

verses.ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكࣱۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.en: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss
And mixed with water of Tasnim
A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.en: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed
And wink one to another when they passed them

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
verses.en: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.en: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray
Yet they were not sent as guardians over them

verses.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.en: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers
On high couches, gazing

verses.ar: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.en: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do
